Unreachable (robots or error), skipped: Ola Veteriner, GomVet, Heka Vet (Beşiktaş), Sahrayıcedit, ModernVet, Medline Vet, Taksim Veteriner Kliniği, Anadolu Veteriner Polikliniği, PetPark Bakırköy, Marina Veteriner, Petricor, Greenpet, Papsivet, Dost Veteriner, LiveVet Bakırköy, Maltepe Platinum, Emar, TherapetVet. Unreachable (robots or error), skipped: Nöbetçi Veteriner/Pethome Küçükçekmece, Gülbağ Veteriner, Neta Veteriner, Vital Veteriner, Bahçelievler Veteriner (bahcelievlerveteriner.com.tr), Kurtköy Veteriner Kliniği, Pets Ultimate, Africa Veteriner Pendik, Yıldız Veterinerlik, Lina Veteriner Fındıklı, Veteriner Anadolu, beyogluveteriner.com (empty page), Vethaven (redirect loop), Veticana /iletisim (not fetchable).
